_README: Group 3 -> Group 4 handoff, TANTRA execution envelope. Format confirmed by Karan Barda (Group 4 Lead) on 2026-08-14. The four null fields are runtime-owned by his instruction and are null BY DESIGN, not by omission.

_format_ruling.supersedes: the two-candidate emitter; Candidate B is not the runtime handoff

_honesty.canonical_store: LOCAL - Group 1 schema v0.1 applied to PostgreSQL 16 / PostGIS
_honesty.note: No Group 3 sensor has produced a recorded reading. This observation was ingested through Group 1's schema on a LOCAL database and read back. Do not treat it as real field data or as a Group 1 instance record.

_trace_convention.source: Group 1 VANA MasterDB Observation API v1.0.0 handoff, Raj Prajapati 2026-08-14, target commit 92a37b337df1fb1d4b8565ada47656d182771cdf. The API returns trace_id in every ingestion, replay, conflict and duplicate response.
_trace_convention.supersedes: the provisional 'trace-vana-<16 hex>' form observed in a Group 4 governed execution on 2026-08-13
_trace_convention.group3_position: Group 3 emits null and never mints a trace. Karan's 2026-08-14 ruling on OWNERSHIP stands - the producer does not mint traces. This fixes only the FORMAT.
_trace_convention.correlation_resolved: Because Group 1's API returns trace_id on ingestion, Group 3 CAN now correlate its submission to the resulting trace. This closes the open question of whether the trace is returned to the producer.

_still_open_with_group4.item: Does Group 4's runtime accept Group 1's VANA-<12 hex> trace, or mint its own?
_still_open_with_group4.status: OPEN - must be settled between Groups 1 and 4
_still_open_with_group4.impact_on_group3: If both mint a trace, one observation carries two identifiers and correlation breaks at the boundary. Group 3 has adopted the Group 1 format and will carry whichever the two groups agree on.
Correlation unproven at Group 4's layer. Not Group 3's to fix, but it means the injected trace is not yet observable end to end.
